newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down as bear-run continues.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down as bear-run continues.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed sharply down on Monday as retail selling intensified amid deteriorating market sentiment, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index dropped 38.12 points or 3.89 percent at 939.66 on a turnover of 38.4 million taka. Losers led gainers by 99 to 17.
Brokers said lack of market moving news and absence of institutional investors continued to depress the market.
"There is no market friendly news. There is nothing that could inspire the small investors," said broker Khurshid Alam.
He said persistent bad weather had also affected the market. "Bad weather has gripped the country. There were not many investors in the market due to torential rains today," he said.
Broker Sabbir Ahmed said investors faced a shortage of cash liquidity. "We are under pressure from banks to pay off loans," he said.

Singer Bangladesh lost 506 taka to 4,972, Bangladesh Lamps dropped 353.89 to 4,038.61 and Amam Sea Food fell 42 to 3,323.33. Beximco Pharmaceutical was the leader with 26,700 shares trading at 115.09 each, down by 8.03 taka.
